NT-WAD-102.summary: Plumber snaked main sewer inspection riser and cleared root intrusion causing toilet backup.
NT-WAD-102.resolution: Temporary clearance achieved; advised main earthenware drainage line requires camera inspection.

NT-WAD-102.summary: Tenant reported slow drainage and gurgling sounds from bathroom shower floor waste.

NT-CAS-101.summary: Safety switch tripped intermittently under air conditioner load. Sub-board inspected.
NT-CAS-101.resolution: Reset circuit breaker, tightened loose neutral link on busbar.

NT-CAS-101.summary: Tenant reported scorched smell from hallway double power point.

NT-DAR-107.summary: Tenant reported faint electrical humming from kitchen wall behind fridge cavity.
NT-DAR-107.resolution: Insulation resistance test completed; intermittent fault suspected in concealed wiring.

NT-JAB-106.summary: Split-system aircon condensate tray overflowing onto internal plasterboard wall.
NT-JAB-106.resolution: Flushed algae buildup from 19mm drain hose.

NT-JAB-106.summary: Plasterboard swelling behind living room air conditioning unit.
NT-JAB-106.resolution: Repaired damp patch with joint compound; advised condensate re-routing.

NT-BAT-108.summary: Water meter creeping forward with internal fixtures closed. Suspected line weep.
NT-BAT-108.resolution: Tightened external brass tap fitting; tenant asked to monitor usage.

NT-NIG-109.summary: Mud tubes identified along external foundation brick veneer perimeter.
NT-NIG-109.resolution: Surface spray barrier applied by pest contractor.

NT-KAT-103.summary: Front wooden entry steps showing dry rot and loose stringer bolt.
NT-KAT-103.resolution: Temporary timber brace installed pending stair flight replacement.

NT-TKT-103.summary: Low water pressure reported at external yard standpipe. Damp soil near meter.
NT-TKT-103.resolution: Turned off isolation valve and tightened compression fitting.

NT-TKT-104.summary: Mosquito intrusion reported through bedroom window.
NT-TKT-104.resolution: Patch mesh applied over tear; frame noted as warped.
